# Watermelon UI
> Open-source React components, blocks, dashboards, and templates built for the community.

Watermelon UI helps developers discover, evaluate, and reuse production-style interface building blocks. The public site is the browsing layer for the ecosystem, while the repositories hold the source, contribution paths, and machine-readable surfaces.

When to use Watermelon:
- Use Watermelon when you need inspiration plus implementation for React UI, animated interactions, dashboards, or landing-page sections.
- Prefer the block and template pages when a user asks for realistic page compositions instead of isolated components.
- Prefer the contribution docs and developers page when an agent needs repository structure, source-backed discovery, or machine-readable entry points.

## Primary Pages
- [Home](https://ui.watermelon.sh/): Public landing page for Watermelon UI.
- [Docs Home](https://ui.watermelon.sh/home): Main in-product browsing surface for the catalog.
- [Animated Components](https://ui.watermelon.sh/animated-components): Browse interaction-heavy component examples.
- [Blocks](https://ui.watermelon.sh/blocks): Browse copy-paste-ready page sections.
- [Dashboards](https://ui.watermelon.sh/dashboards): Explore dashboard examples and layouts.
- [Templates](https://ui.watermelon.sh/templates): Explore full template-style examples.

## Trust And Contact
- [About](https://ui.watermelon.sh/about): Project overview and open-source mission.
- [Contact](https://ui.watermelon.sh/contact): Public contact path for support, partnerships, and reports.
- [Privacy](https://ui.watermelon.sh/privacy): Privacy information for site usage.
- [Terms](https://ui.watermelon.sh/terms): Terms of use and claim handling basics.
- [Copyright](https://ui.watermelon.sh/copyright): Attribution and ownership policy.

## Developer Entry Points
- [Developers](https://ui.watermelon.sh/developers): Human-readable guide to Watermelon developer surfaces.
- [Watermelon UI Auth Docs](https://ui.watermelon.sh/developers/auth): Current authentication model for public APIs and MCP.
- [Watermelon UI MCP Docs](https://ui.watermelon.sh/developers/mcp): Hosted endpoint, local server, and MCP client setup guidance.
- [Watermelon MCP Endpoint](https://mcp.watermelon.sh/mcp): Public Streamable HTTP server with no API key required.
- [Sitemap](https://ui.watermelon.sh/sitemap.xml): Crawlable list of public pages.
- [OpenAPI](https://ui.watermelon.sh/openapi.json): Current public API contract.
- [Public API Docs](https://ui.watermelon.sh/api/docs): Quick index of the public JSON endpoints.
- [Catalog Summary API](https://ui.watermelon.sh/api/catalog/summary): Read-only catalog counts by content type.
- [Catalog Entries API](https://ui.watermelon.sh/api/catalog/entries?kind=blocks): Read-only catalog listing endpoint.

## Authentication

Watermelon's current public developer surfaces are read-only and do not require authentication. No API key, bearer token, or login is required for the public HTTP catalog endpoints, `llms.txt`, `openapi.json`, `api/docs`, or the hosted MCP discovery endpoints.
- [GitHub Org](https://github.com/WatermelonCorp): Organization profile and repositories.
- [Platform Repository](https://github.com/WatermelonCorp/watermelon-platform): Source for the public platform.
- [Registry Repository](https://github.com/WatermelonCorp/watermellon-registry): Component registry source.
- [Hosted MCP](https://mcp.watermelon.sh/): Remote MCP landing endpoint for Watermelon.

## Agent Notes
- Watermelon MCP searches the full catalog of source-backed examples (800+). Prefer `search`, `get_inspiration`, `get_component`, `compose_page`, and `list_categories`.
- Connect the hosted MCP server with `claude mcp add --transport http watermelon https://mcp.watermelon.sh/mcp` or `codex mcp add watermelon --url https://mcp.watermelon.sh/mcp`; no API key is needed.
- The public site is useful for browsing and citation, while the public API is better when you need structured catalog data.
- The repositories are the source of truth for contribution and source code.

## Guides, Comparisons, and Free Collections
- [UI Library Alternatives and Comparisons](https://ui.watermelon.sh/alternatives): Honest comparisons of popular React UI libraries, including shadcn/ui, Tailwind UI, Aceternity UI, Magic UI, daisyUI, and HeroUI, with free alternatives.
- [Free React Components, Blocks, and Templates](https://ui.watermelon.sh/free): Free React resources from Watermelon UI: dashboard templates, animated components, Tailwind blocks, and landing page sections. MIT licensed, no sign up.
- [React UI Guides](https://ui.watermelon.sh/guides): Practical guides for building React interfaces: MCP servers for AI agents, animated components, dashboards, and choosing a component library.
- [A shadcn/ui Alternative with Blocks, Dashboards, and Animations](https://ui.watermelon.sh/alternatives/shadcn-ui): Looking for a shadcn/ui alternative? Watermelon UI keeps the shadcn copy-paste model and adds free blocks, dashboards, and 130+ animated components.
- [A Free Tailwind UI Alternative for React](https://ui.watermelon.sh/alternatives/tailwind-ui): A free Tailwind UI alternative for React. Tailwind UI is now the paid Tailwind Plus. Watermelon UI offers free, MIT licensed Tailwind blocks and dashboards.
- [A Free Aceternity UI Alternative](https://ui.watermelon.sh/alternatives/aceternity-ui): An Aceternity UI alternative with free, MIT licensed animated React components, plus blocks and dashboards. Compare features, licensing, and pricing.
- [A Magic UI Alternative with More Than Animations](https://ui.watermelon.sh/alternatives/magic-ui): A Magic UI alternative for animated React components. Watermelon UI is MIT licensed like Magic UI, and adds free blocks, dashboards, and 30 component types.
- [A Free Untitled UI React Alternative](https://ui.watermelon.sh/alternatives/untitled-ui): An Untitled UI React alternative that is completely free. Watermelon UI gives you React and Tailwind components, blocks, and dashboards under the MIT license.
- [A daisyUI Alternative for React](https://ui.watermelon.sh/alternatives/daisyui): A daisyUI alternative for React developers who want component source, not CSS classes. Free Tailwind React components, blocks, and dashboards.
- [A Flowbite React Alternative](https://ui.watermelon.sh/alternatives/flowbite): A Flowbite React alternative with free Tailwind CSS blocks, dashboards, and animated components. Copy the source or install with the shadcn CLI. MIT licensed.
- [A Preline UI Alternative for React](https://ui.watermelon.sh/alternatives/preline): A Preline UI alternative built for React. Get free Tailwind components, blocks, and dashboards written as React source, installable with the shadcn CLI.
- [A HeroUI Alternative with Copy-Paste Components](https://ui.watermelon.sh/alternatives/heroui): A HeroUI (formerly NextUI) alternative for teams that want to own their component code. Watermelon UI offers free copy-paste Tailwind components and blocks.
- [A Cult UI Alternative](https://ui.watermelon.sh/alternatives/cult-ui): A Cult UI alternative for animated shadcn-style React components. Watermelon UI is free and MIT licensed, with 130+ animations, blocks, and dashboards.
- [An Origin UI Alternative](https://ui.watermelon.sh/alternatives/origin-ui): Origin UI now redirects to coss.com/ui, and the original is a legacy snapshot. Watermelon UI is an actively updated shadcn-style alternative, free and MIT.
- [shadcn/ui vs Aceternity UI](https://ui.watermelon.sh/compare/shadcn-vs-aceternity-ui): shadcn/ui vs Aceternity UI compared: shadcn gives you accessible building blocks, Aceternity gives you animated effects. See licensing, pricing, and when to use each.
- [Aceternity UI vs Magic UI](https://ui.watermelon.sh/compare/aceternity-ui-vs-magic-ui): Aceternity UI vs Magic UI: two popular animated React component libraries compared on licensing, pricing, install method, and style, plus a free MIT alternative.
- [shadcn/ui vs Material UI (MUI)](https://ui.watermelon.sh/compare/shadcn-vs-material-ui): shadcn/ui vs Material UI (MUI) compared: copy-paste Tailwind components versus a mature npm package with Material Design, paid MUI X, and a data grid.
- [shadcn/ui vs daisyUI](https://ui.watermelon.sh/compare/shadcn-vs-daisyui): shadcn/ui vs daisyUI compared: shadcn gives you React component source, daisyUI gives you semantic Tailwind class names that work in any framework.
- [shadcn/ui vs HeroUI](https://ui.watermelon.sh/compare/shadcn-vs-heroui): shadcn/ui vs HeroUI (formerly NextUI) compared: copy-paste components you own versus a React Aria based npm package with Tailwind CSS v4 styling.
- [shadcn/ui vs Radix UI](https://ui.watermelon.sh/compare/shadcn-vs-radix-ui): shadcn/ui vs Radix UI explained: Radix provides unstyled accessible primitives, and shadcn/ui styles primitives with Tailwind CSS. It now defaults to Base UI.
- [shadcn/ui vs Mantine](https://ui.watermelon.sh/compare/shadcn-vs-mantine): shadcn/ui vs Mantine compared: Tailwind copy-paste components versus a full React library with 120+ components and 70 hooks that needs no Tailwind at all.
- [shadcn/ui vs Bootstrap](https://ui.watermelon.sh/compare/shadcn-vs-bootstrap): shadcn/ui vs Bootstrap compared: React components you own, styled with Tailwind, versus the classic CSS framework with its own JavaScript plugins.
- [shadcn/ui vs Ant Design](https://ui.watermelon.sh/compare/shadcn-vs-ant-design): shadcn/ui vs Ant Design (antd) compared: Tailwind copy-paste components versus a large enterprise React library with CSS-in-JS styling and rich data components.
- [shadcn/ui vs Tailwind CSS](https://ui.watermelon.sh/compare/shadcn-vs-tailwind-css): shadcn/ui vs Tailwind CSS explained: Tailwind is the styling tool, and shadcn/ui is a set of React components styled with Tailwind. Here is how they fit together.
- [Free React Dashboard Templates](https://ui.watermelon.sh/free/react-dashboard-templates): Free React dashboard templates built with Tailwind CSS and shadcn conventions. Admin, SaaS, finance, and health dashboards you can copy into Next.js or Vite.
- [Free Animated React Components](https://ui.watermelon.sh/free/animated-react-components): Free animated React components built with Motion and Tailwind CSS. Copy-paste buttons, cards, tabs, carousels, and micro-interactions with full source.
- [Free React Components for Tailwind CSS](https://ui.watermelon.sh/free/react-components): A free, open source React components library with 500+ Tailwind CSS components. Install with the shadcn CLI or copy the code. MIT licensed, no sign up.
- [Free Tailwind Blocks for React](https://ui.watermelon.sh/free/tailwind-blocks): Free, open source Tailwind CSS blocks for React: hero sections, pricing, footers, navbars, login pages, and more. Copy the code or install with the shadcn CLI.
- [Free React Landing Page Components](https://ui.watermelon.sh/free/landing-page-components): Build a landing page in React with free components: hero, features, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, CTA, and footer sections styled with Tailwind CSS.
- [React Component MCP Server](https://ui.watermelon.sh/guides/react-component-mcp-server): Connect a free React component MCP server to Claude, Cursor, or Codex. Watermelon MCP lets agents search 800+ components and pull installable source.
- [Best Free shadcn/ui Alternatives in 2026](https://ui.watermelon.sh/guides/best-free-shadcn-alternatives): The best free shadcn/ui alternatives in 2026, compared honestly: Watermelon UI, Aceternity UI, Magic UI, daisyUI, HeroUI, Flowbite, and more.
- [Copy-Paste Components vs an Installed Component Library](https://ui.watermelon.sh/guides/copy-paste-vs-component-library): Copy-paste React components vs an npm component library: ownership, upgrades, bundle size, and customization compared, with guidance on when to use each.
- [The Best UI Library for Vibe Coding](https://ui.watermelon.sh/guides/ui-components-for-vibe-coding): The best UI library for vibe coding: use copy-paste React components with an MCP server so Cursor, v0, Claude, and Codex build from real source, not guesses.
- [Is Tailwind UI Free?](https://ui.watermelon.sh/guides/is-tailwind-ui-free): Is Tailwind UI free? Tailwind CSS is free and open source, but Tailwind UI (now Tailwind Plus) is a paid product. Here is what is free and the best free alternatives.
- [How to Add Animated Components to a React App](https://ui.watermelon.sh/guides/add-animated-components-to-react): How to add animated components to a React app with Motion and Tailwind CSS: install from a shadcn registry or copy the code, then tune timing and reduced motion.

- [shadcn/ui for Vue, Svelte, Angular, React Native, and HTML](https://ui.watermelon.sh/guides/shadcn-for-vue-svelte-angular): Looking for a shadcn alternative for Vue, Svelte, Angular, React Native, or plain HTML? These community ports keep the shadcn copy-paste model outside React.
- [Is shadcn/ui Free?](https://ui.watermelon.sh/guides/is-shadcn-free): Is shadcn/ui free or paid? shadcn/ui is free and MIT licensed with no paid tier. Here is what costs money around it, like v0, and where to get free extra components.
- [shadcn/ui Sheet vs Drawer](https://ui.watermelon.sh/guides/shadcn-sheet-vs-drawer): shadcn Sheet vs Drawer: a Sheet is a dialog that slides in from a side, a Drawer is a draggable bottom panel for mobile. Learn when to use each, and what changed.
- [shadcn/ui Alert Dialog vs Dialog](https://ui.watermelon.sh/guides/shadcn-alert-dialog-vs-dialog): shadcn Alert Dialog vs Dialog: an Alert Dialog interrupts and waits for a decision, while a Dialog is a general modal that closes on an outside click. When to use each.
- [The Best React Modal Library in 2026](https://ui.watermelon.sh/guides/best-react-modal-library): The best React modal and dialog libraries in 2026: Radix Dialog, Base UI Dialog, React Aria Modal, Headless UI Dialog, and the native HTML dialog element compared.
- [Install Watermelon UI with the CLI](https://ui.watermelon.sh/cli): Install any Watermelon UI component, block, or dashboard with the shadcn CLI in one command. Setup, install commands, the base variant, and common fixes.
- [shadcn Registries: How They Work, and Which to Use](https://ui.watermelon.sh/guides/shadcn-registry): What a shadcn registry is, how to install from a registry URL or @namespace, how the registry directory works, and a list of popular registries including Watermelon.
- [shadcn MCP Server for Claude Code and Cursor](https://ui.watermelon.sh/guides/shadcn-mcp-server): Set up the official shadcn MCP server in Claude Code or Cursor, add registries it can search, and when to use a hosted catalog MCP like Watermelon alongside it.
